text: also. i just painted, quit the app, restarted it, and the paint is gone
resolution: Paint vanished after quitting and restarting. Root cause: persistence stored the texture as raw base64 (1024x1024 RGBA = ~5.3MB base64), which exceeds localstore's 4MB MAX_VALUE cap (storage/localstore.zig) — every set was silently rejected (error.BufferTooSmall) so nothing was ever saved. Fixed by the content-addressed PNG persistence in req_1382 (tens of KB, durable V20 stream). Verified via a probe roundtrip: paint -> bake (PNG+sha256) -> wipe texture to black -> restore from blob -> paint reconstructs intact.
